sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 10 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "A very serious individual has placed an order for an AR on 7.62x39s. Needs an SWS N6 Split handguard, 409mm barrel, ATLAS-7 muzzle, Skeletonized Foregrip, GTL 21 flashlight, Vortex UH-1 sight, HK E1 buttstock, Skeletonized Style 2 pistol grip and a 73-round drum. Ergonomics no lower than 30, weight no higher than 5 kg."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a CMMG Mk47 Mutant to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +29,500 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 1,300 Euros
  - 1,365 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,495 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× SIG Sauer ECHO1 1-2x30mm 30Hz thermal reflex scope
"Great, thank you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
CMMG Mk47 Mutant specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 30 or more ergonomics
- 5 kg or less in weight
- AR-10 Noveske SWS N6 Split handguard
- Mk47 409mm barrel
- AR-10 Odin Works ATLAS-7 7.62x51 muzzle brake
- Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized Foregrip
- Glock GTL 21 tactical flashlight with laser
- Vortex Razor AMG UH-1 holographic sight
- AR-15 HK E1 buttstock
- AR-15 F1 Firearms Skeletonized Style 2 pistol grip
- AK 7.62x39 ProMag AK-A-16 73-round drum magazine

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard CMMG Mk47 Mutant from Skier LL4. It can only be purchased after completing Bullshit.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
